description:
Experience the sublime comfort and rarified strength of Seta Plus TC, a special edition of our popular endurance road chassis formed from Tri-Composite tubing.

When you need to stay sharp past your first century and fresh for the next, Seta Plus TC is one super domestique.

From the valley floor to the crisp cool of the summit, Tri-Composite carbon fiber augmented with metallic filaments takes comfort to a whole new level.

With its innate ability to minimize vibrations and localized mechanical stresses, TC smooths every surface. And in the event of an impact, it supports structural integrity by dampening potentially harmful resonant frequencies.

Seta Plus pairs an exceptionally controlled front fork with space for up to 32mm tires, making it the perfect bike for the peaks and less pristine terrain.

Powerful disc brakes equip Seta Plus for any eventuality. From the fast action of the peloton to endless alpine descents, Seta Plus gives you the confidence to push on under pressure.

Choose an elegant and integrated one-piece bar and stem or the classic aesthetic of a separate handlebar and stem.
